headline: Weathered Expanse And Linn Of Mercy Reel Under Severe Clashes
war_summary: Severe combat has intensified sharply across the northern and central sectors since the last report. Weathered Expanse remains the war's most violent battleground, logging eleven base changes in the past two hours alone amidst surging casualty rates as control over Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Wightwalk continues to seesaw. Combat has reignited in the Linn of Mercy, where accelerating engagements over Rotdust and Outwich Ranch produced three fresh base exchanges, leaving Wardens holding one base against ten Colonial positions. In Mooring County, an immense surge in enlistments accompanied more than two thousand combined casualties over two hours, marking it as a critical hotbed of friction. The Dead Lands also saw renewed fighting around Callahan's Gate, where Colonial forces have secured complete possession of all eleven strategic positions. Further east, Marban Hollow witnessed fresh base exchanges at Mox, while previously volatile sectors in Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf have cooled in recent hours, though contested balances in Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf persist under steady troop pressure.
